title: Flaky: VS Code extension E2E (browser-debugger) times out waiting for Blazor page/WASM debug session to become interactive
test_name: Aspire Blazor browser debugger E2E hits a managed breakpoint for standalone
job_name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, browser-debugger)
error_pattern: Failed to apply E2E control revision ...: Error: Timed out after ~288-295s waiting for Blazor page/WASM root session to become interactive/attach. Last error: <none>. State: {"debugSessions":[{"id":"...","type":"monovsdbg_wasm","name":"Wasm Managed Debugger", ...}]}
analysis: The Blazor browser debugger E2E test timed out after ~288 seconds waiting for the Blazor WASM managed debugger session to become interactive. This is a timing/environment-dependent failure in the VS Code extension's E2E test harness on the Windows runner, unrelated to the PR under analysis (which only modifies Aspire.Hosting.Dotnet options code, not the VS Code extension). This same test/job combination has failed with this timeout pattern many times before.
